title: Lag (1982:80) om anställningsskydd
source: Lag (1982:80) om anställningsskydd, as amended up to SFS 2022:836: 6 § (probation), 6 c § (written information), 6 d § (work abroad) and 6 e § (changes); Sweden's implementation of Directive (EU) 2019/1152. Read 2026-10-08.
note: A drafting check, not legal advice: the scripted rules read whether a particular is there.

rules.text: The statement gives the employer's and the worker's names and addresses, the start date, and the workplace or that the work is done at various places or where the worker chooses.
It describes the work briefly and gives the occupation or job title.
It says whether the employment is permanent, fixed-term or probationary; a fixed term gives its end date or what ends it and whether it is särskild visstidsanställning, vikariat or säsongsarbete.
Pay gives the starting pay and other pay benefits separately, and how often and how it is paid.
It gives the length of the normal working day or week, or how working time is measured when that cannot be fixed.
It gives what applies to overtime or additional hours and their pay, where relevant.
It gives the shortest notice of when the working hours are placed and, where relevant, that they vary between times and days and the rules for shift changes.
An agency worker is told the client companies' names and addresses.
Any right to training the employer provides is given.
The length of the paid holiday is given.
The rules both sides follow to end the employment are given, with the notice periods for a permanent employment.
It says that employer contributions are paid to the state, and any social protection the employer provides.
Any collective agreement that applies is named.
The first paragraph and points 1 to 7 reach the worker by the seventh calendar day after work begins; points 9 to 13 within one month.

Before a worker leaves to work abroad for more than four consecutive weeks: the country, the period abroad, the currency of pay, the cash and in-kind benefits, and whether and on what terms the journey home is paid.
A probationary period is at most six months.
A change to any particular is given in writing no later than the day it applies.
